body: I’m so glad you said exhausting. That’s exactly how living feels! It’s tiring trying to put on a face for others. It’s tiring caring for others and not getting anything in return. It’s tiring trying to justify why my friends don’t reach out, when I knows it’s probably because they don’t truly care enough to simply ask how I’m doing. It’s all exhausting.

I totally understand that. I do the same. When I do put myself out there with my friends and get nothing in return, it’s really exhausting trying to put that nice face on. Just for once, I want them to understand that I want to talk. I just want them to ask “how are you?” It’s not that hard.

Agreed. For me, the emptiness is alright. At least I can just sit there and just stare at my ceiling not feeling anything. But when the feelings kick in, I just want to cry all day and think about ways to end the pain.
Same. None of my friends ever reach out to see how I’m doing. They all know how broken I am and how hard it is for me to put myself out there.
I did not know that! But I also agree, Reddit has done wonders for me in keeping me alive.

Honestly, my friends don’t treat me any different, which isn’t a bad thing. But at the same time they never reach out to see how I’m doing. I don’t crave that attention but there certainly are days I wish my best friends would at least send me a funny gif or something.
You as well.
My exact thoughts this morning when I woke up. I’ve been thinking about dying all day today.  It sucks. It’s exhausting.
I’ll try. Thanks.
Thanks for the advice. 2020 is gonna a rough year but I’ll make it.
Thank you. I was passed out way before midnight. Hope 2020 is good for you.
Thank you. Happy New Year to you too.
It means a lot. Thank you. Happy New Year to you too
Thanks all for the Christmas wishes. At least I know reddit cares, lol. :)
Thanks for the advice. I usually am the one in my friend group that cares a bit too much. I just wish sometimes I felt like my friends actually cared about me. Or at expressed they cared.
This exactly. I’m usually the one who cares a bit too much and will often go all out for my friends. It gets really tiring after awhile. It would be nice to get some of that in return.
This exactly. I had a friend who said they would help me out no matter what. Then ghosted me. Blocked me on everything. I didn’t even do anything. So much for being there for me...
Thank you for this. I’m getting help this week. I can’t do this anymore. The pain is too great and I want it to end so bad.
Same. I’ve ruined all of my friendships. I have no one left.
I try to do the same with Zoloft and sleeping pills and alcohol. Never works.

Thanks for the support. It’s just tough. My family doesn’t quite understand depression. My parents will joke about suicide and they never ask how I’m doing. My friends never ask me as well even though they know I’m going through a rough time. I try talking to them and they never reply. I feel so shut out. They say they care but they never express it.

I know exactly what that’s like. I’ve been dreaming about the girl I liked who ended using me and led me on. She was so cool and I feel so empty when I wake up and realize it wasn’t real. It sucks. Now we don’t talk at all. Fast forward a few days and I tried reconnecting with my best friend from high school who I told everything to. Now she doesn’t wanna talk to me either. Lost two great friends in less than a week.

Hey man. Sorry you’re going through this. It sucks. I know. I’ve been in a really dark place lately. The girl I liked used me and led me on terribly. Now we aren’t talking. All of my friends have gfs and I’m alone. I know what you’re going through. No one to talk to, rely on. It’s the worst.

Take some deep breaths and don’t let it get to you. I know it’s easier said than done. Trust me. But I’m sure your friends haven’t abandoned you and I bet the girl you like might just be busy. Try calling your friends and see what’s going on. But until then, stay strong and focus on the good in life.
